2. What Epoch Tasks is

Epoch Tasks is a personal organizer for to-dos, due dates and reminders. Your data is stored on your device; the optional Cloud Sync (sign-in required) keeps a copy in your account so it can sync between your devices, and lets you connect AI assistants. We offer no other backups or support services. Epoch Tasks is a convenience tool — it is not a substitute for your own diligence in keeping track of important obligations. Descriptions, examples and demos in the app, on our website and in app stores illustrate what it can do; they are not promises about a result, nor advice of any kind.

4. Your data and backups

Syncing can fail, be delayed, or replace one version of a task with another, and a deletion on one device or by an assistant also removes the task elsewhere.

Data can be lost — for example through device loss, damage or reset, uninstalling the app or clearing its data, operating-system or app updates, storage problems, importing an incorrect or damaged file, or software errors in the app. You are solely responsible for keeping your own backups (for example with Settings → Export Data). 5. Accounts and fair use

Cloud Sync is optional and currently free. We plan to make it, and the AI-assistant connections, part of a paid subscription. We'll say so in the app and on epochtasks.app at least 14 days before that applies to you, and you won't be charged unless you subscribe. You can also connect AI assistants, by signing in with Google and tapping Allow or with a personal link; signing in this way creates an account if you don't have one, and these Terms apply to it even if you don't use the app. You are responsible for your sign-in account, for the assistants you allow and for the personal links you create. Only allow assistants you trust and started connecting yourself; anyone with a link can use it to access your tasks, so keep links private. Disconnect assistants and turn off links you no longer use.

Cloud storage is limited (currently 100 KB per attached file and 5 MB of attachments per account), and we may change these limits. Don't use the app or its service to store or share unlawful content or malware, to try to access anyone else's data, to interfere with or overload the service, or to get around its limits. We may suspend or delete an account that breaks these rules.

You can delete your account at any time in Settings → Cloud Sync → Delete Account, or by email (https://epochtasks.app/delete-account.html). An AI assistant can't delete it.

6. Reminders, deadlines and high-risk uses

Reminders, repeats, due dates, countdowns and summaries are provided on a best-effort basis. They can be wrong, delayed, duplicated, missed or not delivered at all — for example because notification or exact-alarm permissions are off, battery optimization or Do Not Disturb, limits on how many alarms a device allows, the device being off or restarted, time or time-zone changes, operating-system behavior, or errors in the app.

Don't use the app for anything where a missed, late or wrong reminder or lost data could lead to death, injury or damage to health or property. This includes taking or giving medicine, medical care or monitoring, emergencies, safety or security systems, the safety of people or animals who depend on you, and operating vehicles, machinery or equipment. If you do so anyway, you do it at your own risk.

For bills, renewals, legal, tax or work deadlines and anything else that could cost you money or rights, the app is only an aid: don't make it your only reminder, and check the real deadline yourself.

You remain fully responsible for meeting your own deadlines and obligations and for checking what matters. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for any consequence of a reminder, due date, repeat, progress indicator or other information in the app being missing, late or inaccurate.

The free version of the app may display ads served by Google AdMob and its partners, purchases are handled by Google Play or Apple's App Store, Cloud Sync runs on Google Firebase, AI assistants you choose to connect (such as Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini) and voice assistants (Siri, Gemini) are provided by their own companies. Once you allow an assistant, what it does with your tasks is treated as done by you: check it, keep backups, and disconnect an assistant that misbehaves. To the extent the law allows, we are not responsible for an assistant's output or actions, for what its provider does with your data, or for decisions you make because of it.

8. In-app purchase

The optional one-time "Remove Ads" purchase removes ad display in the app for the Google or Apple account used to buy it. It is billed and processed by the store you bought it from (Google Play or Apple's App Store), and refunds follow that store's refund policies. To restore it on another device signed in to the same store account, use "Restore Purchases" in Settings.
